purpose: Keep the user variant as the default native build and admit userdebug only through an explicit invocation opt-in; eng is never admitted.
change: Only the user-only variant clause of the predecessor guard is replaced; every other construction restriction is byte-identical.
userdebug_intent: adb root for on-device vendor camera HAL diagnosis (persisted camera properties, vendor camera cache, CHI log masks, kernel log) without a working recovery.

metadata_selection.effect: userdebug/userdebug skips BOARD_NEZHA_PREBUILT_METADATA and its receipt/tool pins; user keeps the full delivery
metadata_selection.consequence: the userdebug package has no injected VENDOR/ODM metadata trees and its packaged vendor/ODM policy images are not verified against the userdebug platform policy; init compiles SELinux policy at boot

product_selection.effect: userdebug/userdebug sets PRODUCT_NOT_DEBUGGABLE_IN_USERDEBUG := false so the diagnostic build emits ro.debuggable=1; user is unchanged
